Ad.D3/10344/2001/CA(Vol.II) 26.09.2026
N O T I F I C A T I ON
Sub: Appointment of Assistant Professor (on Contract) in the Department of Chemical
Oceanography – Notification – Reg.
*****
The Cochin University of Science and Technology invites applications in the prescribed format to
fill up the vacant teaching position in the Department of Chemical Oceanography on contract basis
as detailed below:
1. Name of the Department : Department of Chemical Oceanography
2. Name of post : Assistant Professor (on Contract)
3. No. of Vacancies : 1
4. Subject : Chemical Oceanography
5. Essential Qualifications :
Masters Degree with 55% in Hydrochemistry / Chemistry with
NET
(Essential Qualifications shall be in compliance with the UGC
Regulations 2018)
6. Desirable
Qualifications : Ph.D in the relevant field
7. Specific remarks, if any : -
8. Consolidated salary per
month : ₹45,000/- per month
Those with Ph.D - ₹47,000 /- per month
9. Period of
appointment : Initially for a period of one year with break during vacation
months of May and June on contract basis or till regular
recruit joins duty, whichever is earlier.
10. Application form (online
mode only) : Available in the University website
recruit.cusat.ac.in
11. Mode of remittance :
Online banking (through Net banking or Credit/Debit cards of
almost all banks)
Page 1 of 3
(Payment by cash / Cheque / DD will not be accepted)
12. Application fee : ₹ 950/- for General candidates
₹ 195/- for SC/ST candidates
13. Last date for submitting
Online application : 06.10.2026
14.
Last date for receiving hard
copy of Application along
with
original fee receipt,
Bio-data and supporting
documents
: 13.10.2026
15. Notification No. and Date : Ad.D3/10344/2001/CA(Vol.II) dated 26.09.2026
16.

of the
Application is to be
submitted
:
The Registrar
Cochin University of Science and Technology
Kochi - 682 022
17. Telephone No. of the
Department : 0484-2863403
Interested candidates should apply online through the website recruit.cusat.ac.in before the last
date. The hard copy of the online application as downloaded from the website, strictly adhering to
the terms/regulations mentioned in the Notification should reach the Office of the Registrar, Cochin
University of Science & Technology, Kochi – 682 022 before the last date prescribed along with the
self attested copies of necessary documents in proof of all claims made in the application such as
Qualification, Date of Birth, Reservation etc.
Applications received after the last date prescribed will be summarily rejected. Claims made in the
application without supporting documents will not be considered. Claims which are not mentioned in
the original application submitted will not be considered at any later stage of application processing.
Application fee is not refundable.
Appointments, conditions of service, emoluments and other service benefits shall be governed by
the provisions of KSR, KS&SSR, Act/Statutes/Ordinances and Syndicate Decisions of Cochin
University of Science and Technology as amended from time to time. Communal Reservation Policy
will be followed at the time of appointment treating University Departments/Centres as a single unit.
